Assuming “afternoon” = 12:00–17:00 and a “clean two‑hour block” must not overlap any listed item:

- Clear choices: Thursday (entire afternoon free) and Friday (your 11–12 review ends before the afternoon — e.g., 12:00–14:00 or 13:00–15:00 are both clear).
- Notes: Monday has 12:00–14:00 free (vendor call starts at 14:00). Wednesday has 12:00–14:00 or 13:00–15:00 free (1:1 is 15:00–16:00). Tuesday has no two‑hour afternoon free (offsite 13:00–17:00).

If you use a different afternoon window (e.g., 13:00–17:00), say so and I’ll update.
